featured_reviews.name: Ishita Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
If there’s one place in Mumbai that quietly sets the bar ridiculously high for café dining, it has to be Journal.

Tucked in the lanes of Santacruz West, this spot feels like a hidden gem that you almost want to gatekeep — but it’s too good not to talk about.

Let’s start with the food — because wow.
I tried the Rigatoni Romesco pasta, and I’m not exaggerating when I say it has redefined what a good pasta should taste like for me. Perfectly cooked, rich, and balanced — the kind of dish you keep thinking about days later. The grilled artichoke & mushroom pizza was equally incredible — earthy, flavourful, and done just right.

What makes Journal stand out is that the food isn’t just good — it’s consistently thoughtful. The menu spans across multiple healthy and cheat options, so there’s always something exciting to try.  ￼
And nothing feels like filler — even the simplest dishes feel well-crafted.

The space itself adds so much charm to the experience. You’ve got both indoor and outdoor seating, and the outdoor section especially makes for a perfect brunch vibe. It’s relaxed, airy, and yes — there are quite a few cats casually strolling around, which somehow just adds to the whole personality of the place.

The vibe is exactly what you want from a café — calm, slightly buzzy, and very “slow morning energy.” It’s spacious, comfortable, and great whether you’re working, catching up, or just unwinding.  ￼

And the coffee? Absolutely holds its own. Smooth, well-brewed, and clearly taken seriously — which makes sense given it positions itself as a space for “coffee, culture & conversations.”  ￼

Service is warm and easy — the kind where you don’t feel rushed, and everything just flows.

Overall, Journal isn’t just a café — it’s an experience. One where the food genuinely impresses, the vibe grows on you, and you end up staying longer than planned.

If you’re someone who appreciates great food, good coffee, cozy corners, and a slow brunch done right — this one is an absolute must-visit.

I visited Third Wave Café in Vile Parle just yesterday, and while there were a few highlights, the overall experience left room for improvement.

Service:
Unfortunately, the service was disappointing. Despite the café being nearly empty, we had to wait 20–25 minutes for our order. The staff seemed distracted and unresponsive — even when we tried to call them over, it felt like they were in their own world. This slow and inattentive service really took away from the overall experience, especially since we were quite hungry.

Food:
On the brighter side, the food was excellent. We ordered the Chicken Tikka Roll and Paneer Tikka Roll — both were served in good quantity and tasted delicious. The flavors were spot on, and the food was definitely the highlight of our visit.

Final Thoughts:
If you’re visiting for the food, you won’t be disappointed — it’s tasty and filling. But be prepared for slow service and no parking options. Hopefully, the management takes steps to improve the service quality, because the food truly deserves better support.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Garde Manger Café in Vile Parle East, and while the food was enjoyable, the overall experience was far from satisfying.

Parking:
As with many cafés in this area, there is no dedicated parking available. Visitors traveling by car or bike should be prepared to look around for legal street parking — not very convenient.

Seating & Ambience:
The café offers both indoor and outdoor seating, but the space feels very tight and congested. The tables are extremely small — if you’re planning to order multiple dishes, you’ll struggle to fit everything on the table at once. It gets uncomfortable quickly.

Also, the tables are placed too close to each other, and when the café is full, the noise levels can be overwhelming. During our visit, there was a loud group nearby, and due to the cramped layout, it was hard to have a peaceful conversation or enjoy our food.

Service:
The service was slow and poorly coordinated. We ordered hummus with pita bread, and although we had already finished most of our meal, the pita bread hadn’t arrived. When we followed up, it was clear from the staff’s expressions that they had forgotten to place the order. It eventually arrived after a wait of 30+ minutes, which really disrupted the flow of our meal.

Food:
On the positive side, the food was genuinely good — tasty and fresh. The flavors were spot on, and if I had to rate just the food, I’d give it a thumbs-up.

⸻

Final Thoughts:
While the food is worth trying, the lack of space, poor service, and noisy environment took away from what could have been a nice café experience. I hope the management considers expanding the space and training the staff better to handle orders and communication.

Ambiance

Food and Beverages

Value for Money

featured_reviews.name: priyanka
featured_reviews.review_text:
I met my childhood friend after 10 years and The manager kept hounding us to order something or leave because the cafe had bookings. Mind you, i had ordered and ate 3 dishes from the restaurant + 1 coffee and even that was not enough for them to let us stay and talk for half an hour.
This guy was extremely rude, made a face when i asked him to let us stay atleast 1/2 an hour.
for a customer that ate so much of food from your restaurant and got spoken to in such a rude manner that me and my friend had to pack up and leave, i would never visit again.

Now the food :
Ordered the paneer burger, homemade paneer burger has more taste. The fries that came on the side were 9 pieces in total. This wasn’t hitting so i ordered the pink pasta, bland as anything, even with oregano the pasta could not lift up in flavour. Extremely disappointing food.

My question : For a manager to come and hound us to leave cause his cafe had bookings, one would expect the cafe to be exceptional that so many people are wanting to be here but this was not the case. Staff sucks, manager sucks, meeting my friend after 10 years i wanted to spend the time talking to her and catch up but this restaurant completely and utterly failed us in every element. Cafe’s are supposed to be a comfort corner of the world where people come to share stories, exchange a good time and just be. in the middle of it if you are being hounded and pestered to order again and again and again just to stay in the cafe, sorry but your venture sucks and doesnt deserve to be called a comfort cafe.

featured_reviews.name: Himanshu Kawle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great experience with the Veggie Farmhouse with Chicken Thin Crust Pizza, Soya Chilli Chicken, and Harissa Grilled Chicken Steak with Garlic Mayo.
The thin crust pizza was just how I like it—crispy base, flavorful mozzarella, and perfectly balanced veggies and chicken.
The Soya Chilli Chicken used well-cooked chicken breast pieces with capsicum, onion, and spring onion, all tossed in a perfectly balanced soy sauce with the right hint of white pepper.
The Harissa Grilled Chicken Steak was nicely grilled with a tandoori touch, served with grilled veggies like broccoli, zucchini, carrots, and mashed potatoes.
Overall, the food quality was excellent and truly value for money.

featured_reviews.review_text: I have been a regular customer at August cafe since many years. They have recently redesigned the whole place and has made it more cozy and inviting! featured_reviews.name: Ajay Dogra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stopped by August Café for breakfast and it was a lovely way to start the day — fresh food, relaxed vibe, and great coffee. Special shout-out to Bonny for warm, attentive service that made the visit even better. Will definitely return! ⭐

Edit
Came back to August Café and it was just as delightful as the first visit. Loved the mix mushroom omelette finished with truffle oil — simple, earthy and perfectly done — paired beautifully with a smooth flat white. The café was peaceful in the early morning, with lovely, unobtrusive music setting a calm mood that made the meal even more enjoyable. A great place to start the day, and once again, the service was warm and impeccable. ⭐
